newsitem.title: USA: Circus sees cash from new resort above for.
newsitem.headline: Circus sees cash from new resort above for.

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprises Inc President and Chief Financial Officer Glenn Schaeffer said the company believes its "Project Paradise" resort casino, unveiled on Tuesday, can generate over $136 million in cash flow in its first full year of operation.

Recent research from Salomon Brothers, issued before today's announcement, projected earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, or cash flow, of $136 million and a return on invested capital of 19 percent.
"We would expect a higher figure than (those)," Schaeffer told Reuters in an interview.
